Maya Chen: Heads up — I ran the 6-bit quantized embed model (edge-6b-q6) on the longtail holdout and saw recall@10 drop ~6% on the low-frequency queries.
Samir Patel: ack, can you paste the compare script / results? :eyes:
Maya Chen: gist: https://internal/gists/edge-6q-longtail. Key snippet: `baseline: recall@10=0.78, q6: recall@10=0.72`
Priya Rao: Hmm that's larger than expected. Which dataset? rare-phrases-v2?
Maya Chen: yes — rare-phrases-v2 (20k queries). I also plotted silhouette for clusters and there's a compression of inter-cluster distance.
Jonah: Could this be an L2-norm scaling issue after quantization? We saw similar with int8 where norms collapsed.
Samir Patel: good call. Did you try re-normalizing embeddings post-quant?
Maya Chen: tried `emb = emb / np.linalg.norm(emb, axis=1, keepdims=True)` — recall improved from 0.72 -> 0.74, still below baseline.
Priya Rao: What about per-channel scale vs per-tensor? Our quant pipeline did per-tensor by default for that model.
Maya Chen: Right — I re-ran with per-channel symmetric qparams, command:```bash
run_quant --model edge-6b --mode per_channel --bits 6 --calib small_seedset
```
Maya Chen: That moved q6 recall@10 to 0.755. Cluster silhouette also recovered partially.
Jonah: Nice. Did you check embedding direction drift (cosine) vs baseline?
Maya Chen: I computed pairwise cosine on a 2k sample; mean cosine to anchor set dropped from 0.81 -> 0.77 for per-tensor, per-channel got to 0.79.
Samir Patel: Sounds like per-channel is the way. Two followups: 1) what's throughput/cost delta, 2) any outlier failures (hallucinated nearest neighbors)?
Maya Chen: throughput +18% tokens/sec vs int8 baseline (expected), cost down ~30%. Outliers: ~0.5% queries got nearest neighbor with very low semantic overlap — I attached a short table in the gist.
Priya Rao: Can eval-bot run A/B on current user-simulated traffic to validate production risk?
Maya Chen: yes please — eval-bot, run ab_test with: `model_a=edge-6b-fp16, model_b=edge-6b-q6-perchannel`, traffic=100k sim queries, metrics=[recall@1, recall@5, recall@10, silhouette, tail-failure-rate].
eval-bot: Received AB test request. Scheduling run on eval-cluster. ETA ~45 minutes. :robot_face:
Samir Patel: Meanwhile, let's generate a small calibration checklist for onboard playbook: - require per-channel quant for embed models - normalize after quant step - sanity check recall@10 on longtail + silhouette delta threshold - flag >1% tail-failure for manual triage
Maya Chen: adding those to the PR checklist. Also capturing command used and calib seed: `calib_seed=2026-03-01`, `calib_size=5k`.
Jonah: If AB passes, do we want to add a micro-batch KV-cache test? sometimes caching masks shorter-distance changes.
Maya Chen: good point — add a smoke that pre-warms prefixes and checks NN stability.
Priya Rao: ok. I'll follow up with a short run and open a ticket for rollout gating once eval-bot finishes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
